continuity_scope: Zero-character evidence audit bound to 小野不由美 (Ono Fuyumi)'s Japanese novel 月の影 影の海〔上・下〕（つきのかげ かげのうみ）, 十二国記, Shinchosha/Shincho Bunko edition. The two Japanese volumes are treated as one declared novel witness only. Excludes anime adaptation, later books, guidebooks, unofficial/other translation continuities, and real historical claims.

coverage_rule: No characters or relationships are asserted. One bibliographic evidence-boundary term records the Japanese work-title/edition witness only; no internal terminology is inferred. Authoritative publisher metadata identified the title, author, and edition context, but accessible primary Japanese chapter text was insufficient for defensible character-level extraction.
omissions: All individual character, relationship, and internal-term claims.
Anime-only characters/events, later novels, guidebooks, Tokyopop or other translation localizations, and claims about real China, Japan, or Chinese-derived political vocabulary.
uncertainties: Official Shinchosha pages provide series and volume metadata plus brief marketing description, not a primary-text basis for named-character assertions.
Kanji/kana, romanization, and English localization variants are therefore deferred rather than guessed.
No content warnings or spoilers are asserted without accessible chapter text.
evidence_basis: Authoritative Shinchosha publisher metadata establishes only the Japanese work/edition. The sole source term is an explicitly bibliographic title/edition boundary; no accessible primary Japanese chapter text or complete authoritative translation was available for reliable character, relationship, or internal-term claims.
